readme: # AppDataIsolation Legacy Support - Simple module for enabling /data/data isolation for old Android version (Android 10 and lower). Require [Magisk Process Monitor tool](https://github.com/HuskyDG/magisk_proc_monitor) v1.1+ - Tested on Android 7 and Android 9 and it works. There might be some bugs. - If the module is working, this command shall fail in Terminal Emulator: ``` stat /data/data/com.android.shell ```
readmeHTML:
AppDataIsolation Legacy Support

  • Simple module for enabling /data/data isolation for old Android version (Android 10 and lower). Require [Magisk Process Monitor tool](https://github.com/HuskyDG/magisk_proc_monitor) v1.1+
  • Tested on Android 7 and Android 9 and it works. There might be some bugs.
  • If the module is working, this command shall fail in Terminal Emulator:
    • stat /data/data/com.android.shell
